ciara-bizdev: Heads-up — marketplace handoff for Snow+Databricks connector next Tue (2026-04-07). Need to finalize intent-based routing, schema mapping for vector ingest, and the partner marketplace checklist. Who's on hand for the handover?

alex: I can take routing. Do we want intent-routing by workspace (prod/test) or by dataset type? My suggestion: route low-latency queries to Dedicated pool, batch reindexing to Dedicated-batch or CPU fallback.

maria: for schema mapping, see draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/connector-schema-guidelines — we still need final field mapping for 3rd-party vector stores. cc @jordan on embedding dims.

jordan: embedding dim is 1536 for the model we're listing. Chunking strategy: store doc_id, chunk_id, start_char, end_char, source, ingestion_ts, original_text_preview. Keep metadata <= 1KB. Also need to confirm idempotency keys.

sam: Marketing/sales ask: what's the GA date? Marketplace listing needs screenshots + legal signoff. Can we freeze the API surface by EOD Fri?

ciara-bizdev: Target GA = Apr 14. Freeze API surface by EOD Fri works if eng confirms schema and routing. I'll assemble partner-due checklist and share.

mktg-bot: @ciara-bizdev Draft announcement created: https://redwood.internal/announcements/draft-connector-snow-dbx — please review :eyes:

alex: Routing policy snippet I'm proposing:
```
routing:
  - intent: "retrieval"
    target: dedicated-low-latency
  - intent: "bulk_ingest"
    target: dedicated-batch
  - fallback: regional-cpu
```

maria: quick note — Databricks requires IAM mapping for service principals, Snowflake needs network policy testing. Add both to ops checklist.

jordan: For vector DBs, qdrant + milvus tested; need one more round with Pinecone to validate upserts under heavy load.

ciara-bizdev: Actions: alex finalize routing by Thu; maria finalize field mapping + IAM/network tests; jordan run Pinecone soak test; sam get announcement assets by Mon. I'll run partner dry-run next Wed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for connector-configs scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC — watch release channel.

sam: thanks all — ping me if blockers. I'll sync with legal on the marketplace agreement.
